name: HTML5 Web SpeechSynthesis API
description: Native browser text-to-speech engine providing customizable synthetic voices, pitch, and speed controls without external libraries.

name: Web SpeechRecognition API
description: Speech-to-text recognition interface allowing hands-free voice transcription and spoken command execution in supported browsers.

name: HTML5 Canvas 2D API
description: Pixel-manipulation and 2D drawing context for generating real-time animated graphics, charts, and visualizations programmatically.

name: Web Audio API
description: Modular audio processing engine supporting synthetic sound oscillators, frequency analysis, gain nodes, and binaural soundscapes.

name: HTML5 Geolocation API
description: Direct browser access to device latitude, longitude, and elevation coordinates for distance calculation and proximity sorting.

name: Web Storage API (LocalStorage)
description: Persistent client-side key-value storage engine keeping application records, user preferences, and offline queues intact across sessions.

name: DeviceOrientation & Vibration API
description: Sensor interfaces providing device tilt angles (gamma/beta/alpha) and tactile vibration patterns for physical interaction triggers.

name: Open-Meteo Weather API
description: Keyless open-source weather forecasting API delivering real-time temperature, wind speeds, humidity, and 7-day hourly forecasts.

name: DummyJSON Products API
description: Free REST service providing structured e-commerce product catalogs with titles, ratings, prices, categories, and image URLs.

name: REST Countries API
description: Global demographic and geographic REST API serving country populations, currencies, languages, regional borders, and flag SVG links.

name: Open Library Book Search API
description: Universal public library catalog API allowing search across millions of books, authors, ISBNs, publication years, and cover images.

name: Inspirational Quotable API
description: Curated quote library providing categorized inspirational, wisdom, and philosophical quotes with author profiles and tags.

name: SJCIT Campus Landmarks & Geofence Dataset
description: Curated local JSON dataset containing campus buildings, departmental blocks, canteen stalls, library zones, and GPS coordinates.

name: Recycling & E-Waste Classification Taxonomy
description: Structured local taxonomy detailing hazardous materials, recycling instructions, estimated degradation times, and disposal guidelines.

name: Student Cafeteria Nutrition & Dietary Dataset
description: Comprehensive nutritional registry mapping campus cafeteria dishes to caloric values, protein, allergens, and dietary tags (Vegan, GF, Halal).
